selection_note: Public dataset raw download unavailable; diagnostic subset from reviewed public Blinker issues/PRs, not representative of 50-query multi-repository target.
query_text: verbatim original title only; exclude bodies, comments, hints, patch, test_patch. This avoids embedded solution patches; loses detailed issue context. Apply identically before ranking.
candidate_policy: ALL allowed .py files in each base commit, including tests/docs, never select from patch targets. Existing rag_offline.allowed and chunk_snapshot; function regions only, including overloads/nested functions; max_chars=12000. Fail whole snapshot on limits/unsupported eligible source, no silent file omission.

arms.bm25: Lucene k1=1.5,b=.75 English stemming/stopwords; positive only; max chunk per entity
arms.dense: 1024 exact cosine normalized fsum; max chunk per entity

gold: patch-overlap proxy at base commit; deepest containing function for changed old lines; parent function only if its own lines change. Added/module/class-only changes are file gold and function NA, never inferred from hunk header.
metrics: Hit@k=any gold hit; Recall@k=unique gold hits/number unique gold. Macro question mean, per repo/source type/gold multiplicity/explicit symbol. File projection ranked by best function rank. Partial function labels excluded from primary function denominator, reported separately. Missing result score zero for eligible query. NA separately counted; frozen samples not replaced after rankings.
cache: Zero historical vector reuse. Future within-round dedup only identical endpoint/model/dimension/role/instruct/preprocess/chunker/input text, with exact content hash and settled raw-response+ledger evidence. Repo/commit membership separate.
authorization: No requests to embedding or LLM; historical reservation 1.277952 CNY occupied, unknown .557056 retained; new separately approved budget and manifest required.
stop: No rankings in preparation. Freeze source bytes, labels, query texts, full candidate membership, batches, engine/package hashes and budget before any new results. Initial subset does not freeze uncollected 47 queries.
